text_to_image_prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Reconstruct props seen in input drama reference frames as a clean catalog asset board. 4 columns 3 rows exactly 12 cells. Row-major: worn ivory redstitched baseball; worn brown leather baseball glove; open dark laptop showing blue and green editing waveform blocks with no readable text; compact black audio mixing console with sliders and red white buttons; black overear headphones; black studio microphone with short articulated boom stand and foam windscreen; pair plain red plastic party cups; simple black canvas backpack; black rectangular eyeglasses; burgundy folder with white pages; burgundy goldtrim fountain pen; loose pile of mixed copper and silver coins. Each cell one listed object or coherent set, complete object visible with ample margin. Fully OPAQUE solid WHITE background, no transparency. Neutral soft studio light, matte realistic materials, fine wear and tactile texture. No people, hands, bodies, scenery, labels, watermark, oily shine or excessive gold lighting. Independent props only.
reproduction_note: 依据剧情画面及剧本道具描述重新生成，非原画面像素裁切。格序按从左至右、从上至下。具体轮廓纹理可能与原画面有细微差异；不将剧情中不可见细节视作已核实。
